tos.title: Terms of Service
tos.description: Terms governing the use of the Topiqu platform, subscriptions and AI-generated content.

sections.title: 1. Account
sections.content: By creating an account you enter into a contract to use Topiqu and accept these terms. You must be at least 16. You are responsible for your login details and for all activity under your account; report suspected misuse to support@topiqu.com.

sections.title: 2. Plans and payments
sections.content:
• The prices shown at checkout apply, including VAT where applicable. Payments are processed by Stripe.
  • Subscriptions renew automatically. You can cancel at any time in settings, effective at the end of the billing period.
  • One successful AI generation uses one article. Plan articles are valid for their monthly period; purchased articles do not expire.
  • If a payment fails, we may suspend paid features after notifying you.
We announce price changes in advance by email. They apply from the next period, and you can cancel before then.

sections.title: 3. Withdrawal (consumers)
sections.content: Consumers may withdraw from the contract within 14 days of concluding it by emailing support@topiqu.com. If you asked for the service to start immediately when ordering, you lose the right of withdrawal once the service has been fully provided. If you withdraw while the service is in progress, you pay for the part already provided. We refund within 14 days using the same payment method.

sections.title: 4. Your content and AI
sections.content: Your content, including AI output, belongs to you. You grant us a non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to store, adapt and publish it as far as needed to run the service; it ends when the content or account is deleted. AI output can be inaccurate or similar to output for other users, so review it before publishing. You are responsible for what you publish and for holding the rights to it.

sections.title: 5. Connected services
sections.content: For connected accounts such as LinkedIn or Shopify, you must be authorised to publish, and their use is governed by their own terms. We are not responsible for their outages, limits or actions against your account. You can disconnect at any time in settings.

sections.title: 6. Prohibited use
sections.content:
You must not use the service for:
  • unlawful, misleading, defamatory, discriminatory or harassing content;
  • spam or coordinated inauthentic behaviour;
  • circumventing limits, attacking the service or accessing other customers’ data;
  • automated scraping or reselling access without our agreement.
Violations can lead to suspension or termination. Where a violation can be remedied, we will warn you first.

sections.title: 7. Availability and liability
sections.content: We provide the service without guaranteed availability and may change its features. If we materially reduce a paid plan, we will notify you and you can cancel with a pro-rata refund. We are not liable for indirect loss, lost profit or damage caused by content published without review. Towards businesses, our liability is limited to the amount paid in the last 12 months. Liability that cannot be limited by law is unaffected.

sections.title: 8. Termination
sections.content: You can end the contract at any time by deleting your account. We may terminate with reasonable notice, or immediately for a serious breach or non-payment. If we terminate through no fault of yours, we refund the unused part of your subscription. Export your content before deleting your account; it cannot be restored afterwards.

sections.title: 9. Governing law and changes
sections.content: These terms are governed by Czech law; consumers keep the protection of the law of their country of residence. Disputes are decided by Czech courts, and consumers may also contact the Czech Trade Inspection Authority (www.coi.cz). We announce material changes in advance by email and in the app. If you disagree, you can end the contract before they take effect. If one provision is invalid, the rest remain in force.

sections.title: 10. Operator
sections.content: Topiqu is operated by Vojtěch Benjamín Tomaník, sole trader, company ID 24088765, Czech Republic. The registered address is listed in the ARES register (ares.gov.cz) and available on request. Contact: support@topiqu.com.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: What personal data Topiqu processes, why, who receives it and how long it is kept.

sections.title: 1. What we process and why
sections.content:
We process only the data the service needs:
  • Account — name, email, password hash, settings and, if enabled, your two-factor key. Basis: contract.
  • Content — articles, drafts, comments, media and Knowledge. Basis: contract.
  • Payments — plan, transactions and invoices; card details are handled by Stripe. Basis: contract and accounting obligations.
  • Security — IP address, device, approximate location, sessions and audit log. Basis: legitimate interest in protecting accounts and the service.
  • Analytics and advertising — only with your consent, see Cookies.
We do not sell your data or build advertising profiles from it.

sections.title: 2. AI processing
sections.content: When you generate, translate or analyse content, and when Knowledge is indexed, we send the relevant text to AI model providers. Under their terms, inputs and outputs are not used to train models. AI makes no decisions with legal effects about you. Do not put confidential information or third parties’ personal data into prompts or Knowledge.

sections.title: 3. LinkedIn connection
sections.content: If you connect LinkedIn, we store the profile or page identifier (URN) and encrypted access tokens, solely to publish on your behalf. For posts we publish, we keep only aggregate reaction and comment counts, not who reacted. We do not read your messages, contacts or feed, and we do not use the data for advertising or AI training. We keep tokens and the URN only while connected, and other LinkedIn data only within the limits of the LinkedIn API Terms. We keep tokens and the URN only while connected, and other LinkedIn data only within the limits of the LinkedIn API Terms. We keep tokens and the URN only while connected, and other LinkedIn data only within the limits of the LinkedIn API Terms. We keep tokens and the URN only while connected, and other LinkedIn data only within the limits of the LinkedIn API Terms. Disconnecting in settings deletes the tokens and URN; you can also revoke access directly on LinkedIn.

sections.title: 4. Google Search Console connection
sections.content: If you connect Google Search Console, we request read-only access (webmasters.readonly). We receive your Google account identifier and email, the property you select and search-performance data (page, query, date, clicks, impressions, CTR, position), and use them only for the Search Console features in your workspace: reports, optimisation suggestions and, only when you expressly ask, AI-assisted recommendations. We cannot change your Google settings. We do not sell Google user data or use it for advertising or to train general-purpose AI models; if an AI feature needs to send it to an AI model provider, we tell you beforehand. Our use of data from Google APIs adheres to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements. The refresh token is stored encrypted. Disconnecting in settings deletes the token and stops syncing; previously synced data is deleted with the workspace or on request to privacy@topiqu.com. You can also revoke access in your Google Account.

sections.title: 5. Shopify connection
sections.content: The Topiqu app for Shopify processes the store identification, encrypted tokens, the product catalogue (products, variants, collections, inventory) and blog and published-article data, only for the features you enable. Catalogue data may be sent to AI model providers. We do not read or store customers or orders. On uninstall we delete the tokens, and on Shopify’s request (shop/redact, usually 48 hours after uninstall) also the synced catalogue and connection records. Articles already published in your store remain.

sections.title: 6. Cookies
sections.content: Essential cookies handle sign-in, security, language and storing your cookie choice for 180 days. Analytics cookies (Topiqu statistics for 30 days and, where enabled, Google Analytics 4) and advertising cookies (Google AdSense or Ad Manager, non-personalised ads only) run only with your consent. You can change your choice under Cookie settings in the site footer.

sections.title: 7. Who receives data
sections.content: We share data only with processors bound by contracts under Art. 28 GDPR: Stripe (payments), AI model providers, LinkedIn (only when connected), Amazon Web Services (storage and email, EU), Cloudflare (CDN and security), Sentry (error diagnostics) and Google (analytics and advertising, only with consent). Some are based in the US; these transfers rely on the EU Standard Contractual Clauses or the EU–US Data Privacy Framework. We also disclose data where the law requires it.

sections.title: 8. How long we keep data
sections.content: Account and content for as long as the account exists; after it is closed we delete them without undue delay, and they leave backups as these rotate. Security records for as long as needed to protect accounts, accounting records for the period required by law, and analytics data only with consent.

sections.title: 9. Your rights
sections.content: You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict and port your data, to object to processing based on legitimate interest, and to withdraw consent at any time. You can do most of this yourself in your profile (edit, export, delete account); otherwise write to privacy@topiqu.com and we will reply within a month. You may lodge a complaint with the Czech Office for Personal Data Protection (www.uoou.cz) or your local supervisory authority.

sections.title: 10. Controller
sections.content: The controller is Vojtěch Benjamín Tomaník, company ID 24088765, Czech Republic. The registered address is listed in the ARES register (ares.gov.cz). Contact: privacy@topiqu.com. We announce material changes to this policy by email or in the app.
